SELECT T.*, REQ_QTY - ORDRG_QTY AS REMAIN_QTY FROM ( SELECT A.CO_CD , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REQ_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') REQ_DT , A.REQ_SEQ , (SELECT PRJCT_NM FROM TB_SD05M01 WHERE PRJCT_CD = A.PRJCT_CD) AS PRJCT_NM , A.PRJCT_CD , A.SITE_CD , (SELECT SITE_NM FROM TB_SD09M01 WHERE SITE_CD = A.SITE_CD) AS SITE_NM , A.WH_CD , FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(A.WH_CD) WH_NM , A.TYP_CD , A.IMP_YN , A.DLVR_DTTM , A.REQ_RMK , A.TOT_QTY , A.TOT_WT , A.REQ_MNG_ID , A.ORDRG_YN , A.RECPT_YN , B.ORDRG_SEQ , A.REQ_CREAT_DIV , SUM(B.REQ_QTY) REQ_QTY , (SELECT SUM(REAL_DLVR_QTY) FROM TB_OD01D01 OD01D01 WHERE OD01D01.ORDRG_SEQ = B.ORDRG_SEQ) ORDRG_QTY FROM TB_OD02M01 A , TB_OD02D01 B WHERE A.REQ_SEQ = B.REQ_SEQ AND A.ORDRG_YN = 'N'
AND A.CO_CD = #{coCd1}
AND B.PRDT_DIV IN (SELECT DISTINCT PRDT_DIV FROM TB_BM01M01 WHERE PRDT_GRP = #{prdtGrp1} )
GROUP BY A.CO_CD , A.REQ_DT , A.REQ_SEQ , A.PRJCT_CD , A.SITE_CD , A.WH_CD , A.TYP_CD , A.IMP_YN , A.DLVR_DTTM , A.REQ_RMK , A.TOT_QTY , A.TOT_WT , A.REQ_MNG_ID , A.ORDRG_YN , B.ORDRG_SEQ , A.RECPT_YN , A.REQ_CREAT_DIV ORDER BY REQ_DT, REQ_SEQ ) T

SELECT A.BILG_CERT_NO, A.CO_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(A.CO_CD) AS CO_NM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.SELL_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') SELL_DT, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(A.SELPCH_CD) SELPCH_NM, A.SELPCH_CD, A.CLNT_CD, A.CLNT_NM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.TAX_DT, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') TAX_DT, A.TAX_BILG_NO, A.TAX_DMS5_7240, A.TAX_MOA5_23, A.TAX_MOA5_124, A.TAX_MOA5_388, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(A.RFF_CNO) RFF_CNO, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(A.RFF_VA) RFF_VA, A.TAX_DIV_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(A.TAX_DIV_CD) TAX_DIV_NM, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(A.RFF_GN1) RFF_GN1, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(A.RFF_GN2) RFF_GN2, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(A.RFF_AEA) RFF_AEA, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(A.BGM_1225) BGM_1225, (SELECT CODE_ETC FROM TB_CM05M01 WHERE CODE_ID = A.RFF_GN1) RFF_GN1_CD, (SELECT CODE_ETC FROM TB_CM05M01 WHERE CODE_ID = A.RFF_GN2) RFF_GN2_CD, (SELECT CODE_ETC FROM TB_CM05M01 WHERE CODE_ID = A.RFF_AEA) RFF_AEA_CD, A.BGM_1225 BGM_1225_CD, A.BGM_4343, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(A.XML_FLOW) XML_FLOW, A.TAX_CREAT_ID, A.TAX_CREAT_NM, A.TAXIVC_COPRT, A.TAXIVC_COPRT_NO, A.TAXIVC_COPRT_CEO, A.TAXIVC_COPRT_NM, A.TAX_COPRT_BIZCON, A.TAXVIC_COPRT_BSTY, A.CTAII_MD_2, A.COMII_AL, A.COMII_EM, A.COMII_TE, A.COMII_FX, A.CTAIV_BJ_1, A.TAXIVC_RCV_CRN, A.TAXIVC_RCV_CEO, A.TAXIVC_RCV_ADDR, A.TAXIVC_RCV_BIZCON, A.TAXIVC_RCV_BSTY, A.TAX_RCV_SN, A.TAX_RCV_NM, A.TAX_RCV_EMAIL, A.TAX_RCV_EMAIL2, A.TAX_RCV_FAX, A.TAX_RCV_TEL, A.TAX_MOBLPHON, A.FTXAC1_1, A.FTXAC2_1, A.FTXAC3_1, A.TAX_MOA5_22, A.TAX_MOA5_212, A.TAX_MOA5_308, A.TAX_MOA5_9, A.TRST_QTY, A.TRST_WT, A.TRST_UPR, A.TRST_AMT, A.REAL_TRST_QTY, A.REAL_TRST_WT, A.REAL_TRST_UPR, A.REAL_TRST_AMT, A.BILG_QTY, A.BILG_WT, A.BILG_UPR, A.BILG_AMT, A.TRANS_AMT, A.TRST_DC_AMT, A.ETC_AMT, A.SND_YN, DECODE(A.SND_YN, 'Y', A.SND_YN, 'N', DECODE(A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'Y', A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'N', 'N', NULL, 'N'), NULL, DECODE(A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'Y', A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'N', 'N', NULL, 'N')) AS SND_CHECK, TO_CHAR(A.SND_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') SND_DTTM, A.SND_PROC_ID, A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, TO_CHAR(A.CSEQ_RCV_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') CSEQ_RCV_DTTM, A.TAX_ADMS_YN, TO_CHAR(A.TAX_ADMS_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') TAX_ADMS_DTTM, DECODE(CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'E', 'N', DECODE(A.SND_YN, 'Y', A.SND_YN, 'N', DECODE(A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'Y', A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'N', 'N', NULL, 'N'), NULL, DECODE(A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'Y', A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'N', 'N', NULL, 'N'))) AS RCV_YN,
TO_CHAR(A.RCV_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') RCV_DTTM, A.RCV_PROC_ID, A.ACC_SLIP_NO, A.ACC_SLIP_YN, TO_CHAR(A.ACC_SLIP_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ACC_SLIP_DTTM, A.ACC_PROC_ID, A.ETC_FIELD1, A.ETC_FIELD2, A.ETC_FIELD3, A.ORGN_TAX_BILG_NO, A.INV_SND_YN FROM TB_AR04M01 A WHERE A.SELPCH_CD = 'SELPCH2'
AND A.CO_CD = #{coCd}
AND DECODE(CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'E', 'N', DECODE(A.SND_YN, 'Y', A.SND_YN, 'N', DECODE(A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'Y', A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'N', 'N', NULL, 'N'), NULL, DECODE(A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'Y', A.CSEQ_RCV_YN, 'N', 'N', NULL, 'N'))) = 'N'
ORDER BY SELL_DT DESC, ORGN_TAX_BILG_NO, TAX_BILG_NO, BILG_CERT_NO DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT M.CO_CD , M.ORDRS_NO , M.HIST_NO , M.ORDRS_CLNT_CD , C.CLNT_NM , M.CTRT_NM , M.CLNT_PJT , D.CODE_NM AS CLNT_PJT_NM , CASE WHEN M.ORDRS_DT IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(M.ORDRS_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE '' END AS ORDRS_DT , (SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(D2.DUDT_INTEND_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM TB_CR02D02 D2 WHERE D2.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND D2.ORDRS_NO = M.ORDRS_NO) AS DUDT , U.NAME AS MNG_NM , NVL( (SELECT CASE WHEN ( COUNT(A.TODO_KEY) = SUM(DECODE(NVL(A.SANCTN_STTUS, 'N'), 'N', 0, 'Y', 1) ) ) THEN 'Y' ELSE TO_CHAR( SUM(DECODE(NVL(A.SANCTN_STTUS, 'N'), 'N', 0, 'Y', 1) ) ) END FROM TB_WB20M03 A WHERE A.TODO_NO = M.ORDRS_NO AND A.ETC_FIELD2 = M.HIST_NO AND A.TODO_DIV1_CODE_ID = 'TODODIV20'), 'N') AS APP_STATUS FROM TB_CR02M01 M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BM02M01 C ON M.ORDRS_CLNT_CD = C.CLNT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM05M01 D ON M.CLNT_PJT = D.CODE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM06M01 U ON M.MNG_ID = U.ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND M.CO_CD = #{coCd}
AND ( M.ORDRS_NO LIKE '%' || #{searchValue} || '%' OR C.CLNT_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchValue} || '%' OR M.CTRT_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchValue} || '%' OR D.CODE_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchValue} || '%' )
ORDER BY M.ORDRS_DT DESC, M.ORDRS_NO DESC, M.HIST_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 30

SELECT M.CO_CD , M.ORDRS_NO , M.HIST_NO , C.CLNT_NM , M.CTRT_NM , (SELECT FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.CLNT_PJT) FROM DUAL) AS CLNT_PJT_NM , CASE WHEN M.ORDRS_DT IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(M.ORDRS_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE '' END AS ORDRS_DT , (SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(D2.DUDT_INTEND_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM TB_CR02D02 D2 WHERE D2.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND D2.ORDRS_NO = M.ORDRS_NO) AS DUDT -- Step 1. 수주/원가 결재 상세 상태 (TB_WB20M03 기반: ordrsNo + histNo 차수 복합키 격리) , NVL( (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(A.TODO_KEY) = 0 THEN 'NONE' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(A.APPR_REJECT_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'REJECT' WHEN COUNT(A.TODO_KEY) = SUM(DECODE(NVL(A.SANCTN_STTUS, 'N'), 'N', 0, 'Y', 1)) THEN 'COMPLETE' WHEN SUM(DECODE(NVL(A.SANCTN_STTUS, 'N'), 'N', 0, 'Y', 1)) = 0 THEN 'REQUEST' ELSE 'PROGRESS' END FROM TB_WB20M03 A WHERE A.TODO_NO = M.ORDRS_NO AND A.ETC_FIELD2 = M.HIST_NO AND A.TODO_DIV1_CODE_ID = 'TODODIV20'), 'NONE') AS STEP1_APP_STATUS , NVL( (SELECT COUNT(A.TODO_KEY) FROM TB_WB20M03 A WHERE A.TODO_NO = M.ORDRS_NO AND A.ETC_FIELD2 = M.HIST_NO AND A.TODO_DIV1_CODE_ID = 'TODODIV20'), 0) AS STEP1_APP_TOT_CNT , NVL( (SELECT SUM(DECODE(NVL(A.SANCTN_STTUS, 'N'), 'N', 0, 'Y', 1)) FROM TB_WB20M03 A WHERE A.TODO_NO = M.ORDRS_NO AND A.ETC_FIELD2 = M.HIST_NO AND A.TODO_DIV1_CODE_ID = 'TODODIV20'), 0) AS STEP1_APP_COMP_CNT , NVL( (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(A.APPR_REJECT_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM TB_WB20M03 A WHERE A.TODO_NO = M.ORDRS_NO AND A.ETC_FIELD2 = M.HIST_NO AND A.TODO_DIV1_CODE_ID = 'TODODIV20'), 0) AS STEP1_APP_REJECT_CNT , NVL( (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(A.TODO_KEY) > 0 AND COUNT(A.TODO_KEY) = SUM(DECODE(NVL(A.SANCTN_STTUS, 'N'), 'N', 0, 'Y', 1)) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM TB_WB20M03 A WHERE A.TODO_NO = M.ORDRS_NO AND A.ETC_FIELD2 = M.HIST_NO AND A.TODO_DIV1_CODE_ID = 'TODODIV20'), 'N') AS STEP1_APP_YN , NVL( (SELECT MAX(X.CNFM_YN) FROM TB_CR02D02 X WHERE X.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND X.ORDRS_NO = M.ORDRS_NO), 'N') AS STEP1_CNFM_YN -- Step 2. 일정/설계 (WB/BM) , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_WB22M01 W WHERE W.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND W.SALES_CD IN (SELECT D.SALES_CD FROM TB_CR02D02 D WHERE D.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND D.ORDRS_NO = M.ORDRS_NO)) AS STEP2_WBS_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BM14M01 B WHERE B.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND B.SALES_CD IN (SELECT D.SALES_CD FROM TB_CR02D02 D WHERE D.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND D.ORDRS_NO = M.ORDRS_NO)) AS STEP2_BOM_CNT -- Step 3. 구매/외주 (SM) , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SM02M01 S2 WHERE S2.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND S2.SALES_CD IN (SELECT D.SALES_CD FROM TB_CR02D02 D WHERE D.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND D.ORDRS_NO = M.ORDRS_NO)) AS STEP3_REQ_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SM10M01 S10 WHERE S10.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND S10.SALES_CD IN (SELECT D.SALES_CD FROM TB_CR02D02 D WHERE D.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND D.ORDRS_NO = M.ORDRS_NO)) AS STEP3_ORDRG_CNT -- Step 4. 생산/조립 (PM) , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PM01M01 P WHERE P.ORD_CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND P.SALES_CD IN (SELECT D.SALES_CD FROM TB_CR02D02 D WHERE D.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND D.ORDRS_NO = M.ORDRS_NO)) AS STEP4_WORK_CNT -- Step 5. 품질/검사 (QM/WB) , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_QM01M01 Q WHERE Q.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND Q.SALES_CD IN (SELECT D.SALES_CD FROM TB_CR02D02 D WHERE D.CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND D.ORDRS_NO = M.ORDRS_NO)) AS STEP5_QM_CNT -- Step 6. 출하/정산 (TR) , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TR01M01 T WHERE T.TRANS_ORDRS_CO_CD = M.CO_CD AND T.TRANS_ORDRS_NO = M.ORDRS_NO) AS STEP6_TR_CNT FROM TB_CR02M01 M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BM02M01 C ON M.ORDRS_CLNT_CD = C.CLNT_CD WHERE M.ORDRS_NO = #{ordrsNo} AND M.HIST_NO = #{histNo}
AND M.CO_CD = #{coCd}
